name: Korean peninsula
summary: North Korea tested a cluster-warhead ballistic missile on 31 Oct
state: North Korea fired a tactical ballistic missile towards the Yellow Sea from near Chongju on 31 Oct, testing a cluster warhead, two days after a salvo of about ten short-range missiles on 29 Oct (Yonhap via ANI). Pyongyang says it will field several warhead types by year-end. The US says Trump is open to talks; none are scheduled, and no further launch had been reported by late on 1 Nov.
for_you: No direct risk to the UK. Travellers to South Korea can follow FCDO travel advice.
